summary: Explored model scaling and hyperparameter optimization within VRAM constraints. Found that increasing depth from 8 to 10 substantially improves validation loss (1.012347→1.001942). Further gains (to 1.001167) came from tuning learning rates, batch norm parameters, and LR schedules. Attempts to go deeper (depth=11+) hit OOM; wider models also exceeded memory limits. The sweet spot is depth=10 with carefully tuned optimization.
